# Element criteria: layers, state and work (C25 to C38, C40)

Extra checks for overlays, feedback states and workflow elements, on top of the eight gates. Source: `frontend/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md` §8.4. Where this file and the guide differ, the guide wins; where the guide and `frontend/DESIGN.md` differ, the product contract wins. Other groups: [structure and navigation](./element-criteria-structure.md), [actions and input](./element-criteria-actions.md), [data and content](./element-criteria-data.md).

Columns: Place · Semantics and markup · Copy · Colour · Red flags (duplicate or risk signals).

| ID | Element | Place | Semantics | Copy | Colour | Red flags |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C25 | Tooltip, help, preview card | near the element, not covering | `role="tooltip"`, also on focus; content on hover or focus can be dismissed (Esc), hovered over and stays (WCAG 1.4.13) | supplement only; never essential info | inverse surface | essential info only in a tooltip; hover-only; a card that Esc does not close, that vanishes under the pointer or that covers the rows being read |
| C26 | Popover, dropdown | beside trigger, on screen | `popover` or disclosure pattern; a list of navigation links gets no `menu` role: a named `nav` holding an `aria-expanded` button and a link list; Esc closes and returns focus to the button, leaving the region closes it; arrows, Home and End are optional and never replace Tab; a command menu uses the `menu` pattern: Up and Down move between items and Tab closes it (§5.6) | verb plus object items | neutral surface plus shadow | form and menu mixed; `menu` role on a link list; Tab moving between items of a command menu |
| C27 | Modal, confirm dialog | centred; footer buttons per product rule | `dialog`, `aria-modal`, title linked | title = action, body = impact | `danger` only if destructive | "OK" without target and impact; no way out; an input modal with more than 5 input components (KRDS) |
| C28 | Drawer, detail panel | beside the related row or item | state whether modal | title = target name | neutral | covers the primary work area; closing loses context |
| C29 | Accordion, disclosure, any show-hide toggle | content below the heading | button with `aria-expanded` (`true` or `false`), toggled by Enter and Space; linking the region with `aria-controls` is optional | heading previews content | neutral | important warning folded away; a toggle without `aria-expanded`; a toggle that opens a second copy of a control already on the page |
| C30 | Toast, banner, inline notice | scope-matched place (§5.8) | `role="status"` or `alert` | one line of event plus next action | status colour plus icon plus text | one event over several channels |
| C31 | Spinner, skeleton, progress | inside the area that will change | `progress`, `aria-busy` | "Loading" plus target | neutral | fake progress; endless spinner; frame-only skeleton |
| C32 | Empty, error, offline state | inside the empty area | title, description, action | cause plus next action | only errors use status colour | permission error shown as "none"; an invented cause; "team notified" without automatic reporting; an empty-state action competing with the primary button |
| C33 | Stepper, wizard | steps above, navigation below | current step `aria-current="step"`; each step is a history entry so browser Back goes to the previous step (design choice) | step name = result gained | done, current, remaining distinct | step name differs from page title; earlier values lost; Back leaves the form and drops input; a failed submit followed by a reload loses input |
| C34 | Approve, delete, bulk action | near target; scope shown | confirmation step for risk, its level matched to the risk (§5.4) | "Delete 3 rules": target included | only risk uses `danger` | unclear scope (page, filter, all); double execution; a selection that reaches rows not visible |
| C35 | Theme, density, view settings | one place in the tool area | personal or shared scope shown | scope and whether it is saved | measure both themes | applies on some screens only |
| C36 | Login, permission, session | one place | authentication state and permission separated | reason for limit plus how to request, plus what works without it when something does; a sign-in or reset failure gets one generic sentence that does not reveal the account, a lock or the wrong credential | n/a | no permission shown as an empty result, sign-in error naming the wrong credential or a locked account, raw exception text, input lost when the session expires |
| C37 | AI suggestion, chat, generated result | next to evidence; apply after review | states from §7.2 | "Generated", "Needs evidence" marked | success colour never implies verification | explanation mistaken for evidence; regenerate overwrites a draft |
| C38 | UX copy, onboarding, contextual help | at the point of need | n/a | user's words; one concept one term; says what the user needs, not why the page was built that way | n/a | same concept with different names; reliance on a tutorial; production-memo tone ("this page only offers X because Y was not provided") |
| C40 | Consent or cookie banner | docked at an edge without pushing content; height at most 1/4 of the viewport (design choice) | named `region`; first Tab stop only if it blocks | plain choices of equal weight ("Accept", "Reject"), what is collected, how to change it later | equal choices share one style; nothing pre-selected | banner over 1/4 of the viewport; reject harder than accept; first quick link below the fold |
